resources.string: Not set · for when your face or fingerprint won\'t work: something only you know, asked for instead of your screen lock
On · if your face or fingerprint won\'t work, locked apps and BioKey ask for it instead of your screen lock
Set, but not asked for: Face or fingerprint only is off, so your screen lock works instead
On · with no face or fingerprint to use, locked apps and BioKey ask for it, not your screen lock
On, but no face or fingerprint is set up: your passphrase works meanwhile

If your face or fingerprint won\'t work, locked apps and BioKey ask for this instead of your screen lock, so don\'t make it the same as your screen lock. If you forget it, nothing is lost: change or remove it here with your face or fingerprint.
The new one replaces the old one. Keep it different from your screen lock.
When your face or fingerprint won\'t work, there\'ll be no other way into locked apps and BioKey until it does. You can set a new passphrase here at any time.
Your screen lock will open locked apps and BioKey until a face or fingerprint can be used again. You can set a new passphrase here once one can.
Locked apps and BioKey won\'t ask for it again. You can set a new passphrase here at any time.
